description.narrative: The project strengthens the participation of marginalised groups (women, youths, PWDs) in decision-making through: (a) increased participation of women, youths and PWDs in decision-making and accountability processes; (b) women youth, persons with disabilities and other marginalised groups have increased access to economic resources and financial skills; (c) increased advocacy, networking and lobbying on governance, development, inclusion and representation; and(d) SENDSL’s capacity is improved to deliver programs effectively and efficiently. The project will support implementation of climate actions in local development plan and empower marginalised groups to hold decision makers to account and improve local service delivery through enhanced participation in accountability processes. The project will also increase women’s voices through the expansion of media programming at district and national levels and support women in leadership training in tertiary institutions.
